title: GTA VI Is Still a Mystery Even to Grand Theft Auto’s Original Creators
description: Dave Jones and Brian Baglow, key creators of the original Grand Theft Auto, reveal they have not played GTA VI before its release, as shared in a BBC News interview reported by RockstarINTEL. The discussion covers their wait for release and memories of the series' origins.
youtubeTitle: GTA VI Creators Admit They Haven't Played Game Before Release
socialHook: Even the original creators of Grand Theft Auto haven't played GTA VI before its release.

sections.heading: Creators Await GTA VI Release
paragraphs: With GTA VI just days from release, Dave Jones and Brian Baglow -- key figures behind the original Grand Theft Auto -- have yet to play Rockstar's upcoming title. Both recently spoke to BBC News, with Jones stating, "We're all waiting to see what they've done." Baglow confirmed he has pre-ordered his copy, highlighting that even the franchise's pioneers must wait for release day to experience the new game.

sections.heading: Memories of Original GTA Development
paragraphs: The interview also dug into the origins of the series, revealing that Grand Theft Auto began as a racing project called Race 'n' Chase before granting players freedom to exit vehicles and steal others. Jones explained the team considered allowing players to become police officers but ultimately chose the criminal perspective. The developers also discussed creating fictional businesses, radio stations, and DJs due to expensive real-world licensing, with these custom elements becoming central to the series' unique identity.
